quote: You spend your life chasing distant horizons, believing meaning waits where you have never been. Yet silence lingers in the empty rooms behind you. Every fleeting shadow demands an answer you cannot give. We wander through years looking for what we left behind. Home was never a place you could finally touch. It was always just the quiet space within your own chest.
